# ADR-3206: AWS iam: Documented break-glass IAM role for account 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Break-glass access is sometimes is expected to.

## Decision

Security teams MAY adopt a documented break-glass IAM role for account 6 (AWS-iam-6) when recovering from lockouts.

## Consequences

Assumptions are dual-controlled and logged.
